import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

DATASET_PATH = 'chunks_csv/moran_global_2022_waste.csv'
ADJACENCY_PATH = 'chunks_csv/borough_adjacency.csv'

df = pd.read_csv(DATASET_PATH)
adj = pd.read_csv(ADJACENCY_PATH)

# Consistent ordering
boroughs = sorted(df['borough'].unique())
n = len(boroughs)
b2i = {b: i for i, b in enumerate(boroughs)}

# Build symmetric binary weights matrix
W = np.zeros((n, n), dtype=float)
for _, row in adj.iterrows():
    b = row['borough']
    nb = row['neighbor']
    if b in b2i and nb in b2i:
        i = b2i[b]
        j = b2i[nb]
        W[i, j] = 1.0
        W[j, i] = 1.0

# Ensure no self-weights
np.fill_diagonal(W, 0.0)

S0 = W.sum()
print('n:', n)
print('S0:', S0)

# Get waste values in borough order
x = df.set_index('borough').reindex(boroughs)['Waste_value'].values
z = x - x.mean()

# Moran's I
numer = np.dot(z, np.dot(W, z))
denom = np.dot(z, z)
I_obs = (n / S0) * (numer / denom)
print('Observed Morans I:', I_obs)

# Permutation test (1000 shuffles)
np.random.seed(42)
n_perm = 1000
I_perm = np.empty(n_perm)
for k in range(n_perm):
    z_perm = np.random.permutation(z)
    numer_p = np.dot(z_perm, np.dot(W, z_perm))
    I_perm[k] = (n / S0) * (numer_p / denom)

# One-sided p-value (positive autocorrelation)
p_one = (I_perm >= I_obs).mean()
# Two-sided p-value
expected_I = -1.0 / (n - 1)
p_two = (np.abs(I_perm - expected_I) >= np.abs(I_obs - expected_I)).mean()

print('Expected I under random:', expected_I)
print('One-sided p-value:', p_one)
print('Two-sided p-value:', p_two)
```

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

DATASET_PATH = 'chunks_csv/moran_global_2022_waste.csv'
ADJACENCY_PATH = 'chunks_csv/borough_adjacency.csv'

df = pd.read_csv(DATASET_PATH)
adj = pd.read_csv(ADJACENCY_PATH)

# Drop borough with missing waste value
df_clean = df.dropna(subset=['Waste_value']).copy()
boroughs = sorted(df_clean['borough'].unique())
n = len(boroughs)
b2i = {b: i for i, b in enumerate(boroughs)}

# Build symmetric binary weights matrix for remaining boroughs
W = np.zeros((n, n), dtype=float)
for _, row in adj.iterrows():
    b = row['borough']
    nb = row['neighbor']
    if b in b2i and nb in b2i:
        i = b2i[b]
        j = b2i[nb]
        W[i, j] = 1.0
        W[j, i] = 1.0

np.fill_diagonal(W, 0.0)
S0 = W.sum()

# Get waste values in consistent order
x = df_clean.set_index('borough').reindex(boroughs)['Waste_value'].values
z = x - x.mean()

# Moran's I with binary weights
numer = np.dot(z, np.dot(W, z))
denom = np.dot(z, z)
I_obs = (n / S0) * (numer / denom)
print('Observed Morans I (binary weights):', I_obs)

# Permutation test with 10000 shuffles
np.random.seed(42)
n_perm = 10000
I_perm = np.empty(n_perm)
for k in range(n_perm):
    z_perm = np.random.permutation(z)
    numer_p = np.dot(z_perm, np.dot(W, z_perm))
    I_perm[k] = (n / S0) * (numer_p / denom)

# One-sided p-value (positive autocorrelation)
p_one = (I_perm >= I_obs).mean()
# Two-sided p-value
expected_I = -1.0 / (n - 1)
p_two = (np.abs(I_perm - expected_I) >= np.abs(I_obs - expected_I)).mean()

print('Expected I under random:', expected_I)
print('One-sided p-value:', p_one)
print('Two-sided p-value:', p_two)
print('Mean perm I:', I_perm.mean())
print('Std perm I:', I_perm.std())

# Also compute with row-standardized weights for comparison
row_sums = W.sum(axis=1)
W_row = W.copy()
for i in range(n):
    if row_sums[i] > 0:
        W_row[i, :] = W_row[i, :] / row_sums[i]

S0_row = W_row.sum()
numer_row = np.dot(z, np.dot(W_row, z))
I_obs_row = (n / S0_row) * (numer_row / denom)
print('Observed Morans I (row-standardized):', I_obs_row)

I_perm_row = np.empty(n_perm)
for k in range(n_perm):
    z_perm = np.random.permutation(z)
    numer_p = np.dot(z_perm, np.dot(W_row, z_perm))
    I_perm_row[k] = (n / S0_row) * (numer_p / denom)

p_one_row = (I_perm_row >= I_obs_row).mean()
p_two_row = (np.abs(I_perm_row - expected_I) >= np.abs(I_obs_row - expected_I)).mean()
print('Row-standardized one-sided p:', p_one_row)
print('Row-standardized two-sided p:', p_two_row)
```
